personalInfo.name: Ruturaj Jayant Kotwal
personalInfo.tagline: AI & Software Engineer | Cloud-Native & Data Pipelines
personalInfo.bio: AI & software engineer with 3+ years of experience building cloud-native applications, data pipelines, and automation workflows across GCP, AWS, and modern JavaScript & Python ecosystems.

experience.description: Designed an agentic-AI-driven automation framework for corporate action processing on Google Cloud. Built a proof-of-concept system by engineering BigQuery pipelines and prototyping autonomous workflows using Vertex AI.
Completed the DB Cloud Developer sprint with hands-on development in GCP services. Supported production teams by debugging Python-based internal data-processing tools, improving system reliability.

Migrated a legacy PHP CRM into a Vue.js component-based architecture. Built event-driven AWS Lambda functions. Implemented multi-step automation workflows using Zapier. Optimized API data-fetching logic.
Contributed to a JavaScript-based web application. Developed and maintained Jest unit tests for UI components and utilities.
Identified and resolved bugs in production code, gaining early experience in debugging, code reviews, and release cycles.

projects.title: Speech-controlled Object Recognition
projects.description: Developed a Python and OpenCV solution for real-time voice-activated object recognition for Nao6 Robot. Tested an AI-driven prototype that enabled responsive interaction through REST API integration.

projects.title: Multi-modal LLMs vs Specialist AI
projects.description: Benchmarked multimodal LLMs against specialist computer vision models across tasks (classification, detection, segmentation), highlighting their performance trade-offs.

projects.title: E-Commerce Analytics Platform
projects.description: Built a cloud data warehouse in BigQuery by processing and integrating 9 raw datasets. Delivered business insights through dashboards highlighting product performance and customer trends.

projects.title: Automated Object Detection & Sorting
projects.description: Implemented real-time color detection using YOLOv7 + OpenCV to control conveyor operations and robotic sorting. Added a WhatsApp-based alert system.

projects.title: Healthcare Analytics
projects.description: Pre-processed complex tabular datasets and engineered features from ICD-9 medical codes. Built a classification model to predict 30-day readmission risk.

projects.title: Intrusion Detection System
projects.description: Developed a high-accuracy (95%+) model to classify malicious vs. benign network traffic using the CIC-IDS2017 dataset. Leveraged XGBoost and Keras-based MLP.
